note: The viewfinder's numbers (commons/void/camcorder_hud.gd reads them; commons/void/hud_config.gd carries them). A file of this shape sent to a running game with `python tools/push_hud_config.py <file>` is laid over this one and takes effect within half a second, no build. Only the keys you want to change need be in the sent file. vr: frame_width_m and frame_height_m are the plane's size, distance_m how far in front of the eyes it floats, so the corner symbols sit about atan(frame_width_m / 2 / distance_m) degrees out to the side (2.1 at 1.2 = 41). vertical_offset_m moves the whole plane down (negative) or up. pixels_wide is the sharpness of the plane's picture (its height follows the plane's shape). text_scale and margin_scale multiply the letter size and the gap between the frame's edge and the symbols. sung_line_at is where the foot of the sung line sits, 0 the top of the plane and 1 the bottom; sung_line_width is how much of the width it may take before it wraps. desktop: the same text_scale, margin_scale and sung_line_width; sung_line_at 0 keeps the line just above the bottom row.
